title.value: Can Subnetwork Structure be the Key to Out-of-Distribution Generalization?
title.justification: The paper extensively discusses the potential role of subnetwork structures in achieving better out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in deep learning models.
title.quote: Can Subnetwork Structure be the Key to Out-of-Distribution Generalization?

analysis.description: This paper investigates whether specific subnetwork structures within neural networks can improve out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. It introduces the functional lottery ticket hypothesis, suggesting that a full network contains a subnetwork that can achieve better OOD performance. The paper proposes an algorithm called Modular Risk Minimization (MRM) to identify these subnetworks and demonstrates its effectiveness in various OOD tasks.

type.justification: The paper includes experiments on datasets and evaluates the performance of proposed methods, indicating its empirical nature.
type.quote: Experiments on various OOD generalization tasks corroborate the effectiveness of our method.
